sentences.text: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah -LRB- English : Taarak Mehta 's Different Perspective -RRB- is India 's longest running sitcom serial produced by Neela Tele Films Private Limited .	Taarak Mehta	Taarak Mehta	Neela Tele Films Private Limited	Neela Tele Films Private Limited	English	English language	sitcom	sitcom
The show went on-air on July 28 , 2008 .
It airs from Monday to Friday at 8:30 pm , with its repeat telecast at 11:00 pm and the next day at 3:00 pm on SAB TV .	SAB TV	SAB TV
The show started its re-run on Sony Pal from November 2 , 2015 at 4:30 pm and 8:00 pm everyday .	Sony Pal	Sony Pal

The show is based on the column Duniya Ne Oondha Chashma written by columnist and journalist Taarak Mehta for Gujarati weekly magazine Chitralekha .	Taarak Mehta	Taarak Mehta	Gujarati	Gujarati language	Chitralekha	Chitralekha (weekly)
